item.title: 【Helpdesk】[HELP] SharePoint links
item.description:
Hello everyone, I hope you’re all doing well.

I’m new here and wanted to say that ShareMania has been really helpful for my Dolby Atmos listening experience. I appreciate all the posts and shared content.

I tried searching but couldn’t find anything about this issue. All the SharePoint links return an “Access Denied” message, and the URL changes to something containing “FraudThrottle.”

The page says: “This page has been blocked because it violates the Acceptable Use Policy outlined in the Terms of Use. If you believe this is an error, please contact our Support team through the M365 Admin Center for further assistance.”

I don’t believe all the links are actually broken… or are they? I haven’t been able to access a single link from that site. Does anyone know a way around this?

I’ve already tried enabling and disabling VPN, using incognito mode, online proxy browsers, switching browsers, and even accessing it from my phone, but nothing worked. I’d really like to be able to download these files.

Thanks in advance!
